readme_quotes: Clone this repo and do an editable installation: pip install -e .
If you want to use Jax on the GPU, you need to install the following: pip install jax["cuda12"]
LocoMuJoCo provides three sources of motion capture (mocap) data... will downloaded and cached automatically for you.
ambiguities: CUDA version: README does not pin a CUDA version. Probe detected host driver capability CUDA 12.8 — using jax[cuda12] wheel to match. Base image uses nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-cudnn-runtime-ubuntu22.04.
PyTorch not required for core benchmark (only optional smpl extra); no torch dep in install plan.
wandb and imageio[ffmpeg] are not in core deps but are required for training examples and video recording respectively.
